title: REQ · Overlay anchor is a pure function of native position, scale, canvas offset and DPR
summary: A pure anchorFor function maps an object's native bounds to a screen point and is recomputed on resize.
description: Context: PhaserHost computes zoom via computeZoom(w,h,dpr) in frontend/src/phaser/config.ts and re-applies it on resize. There is no function that converts an object's native position to a DOM position. Desired: a pure function takes the object's position, interactionBounds, scale, the whole-number zoom, the canvas offset in CSS pixels and DPR, and returns the top-centre and bottom-centre screen points. Expected result: the overlay can be placed over the canvas at any zoom. Why: anchors must be exact and testable without Phaser.
acceptance_criteria: Given position (150,60), bounds 48x96, scale 1, zoom 2, offset (10,20), DPR 1, When anchorFor runs, Then top-centre is (10+(150+24)*2, 20+60*2) and bottom-centre is (10+(150+24)*2, 20+(60+96)*2)
Given DPR 2 and a device-pixel zoom of 4, When anchorFor runs, Then the CSS-pixel result equals the DPR 1 zoom 2 result
Given an object without interactionBounds, When anchorFor runs, Then it returns null

in_scope: Reading canvas offset and zoom from the Phaser host on resize

technical_constraints: No position hardcoded; values come from ObjectSpec
definition_of_done: anchorFor exported and used by the overlay
PhaserHost reports canvas rect and zoom on resize and DPR change
non_functional: Pure, no DOM or Phaser access inside anchorFor
